```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Validation rules:
1) Check for Duplicate Records
2) Check for empty columns - some empty columns are expected, as this will be for all years without ABS
3) Check for negative statistics
4) Check challenge wins and losses
5) Check win percentages to ensure it is between 0 and 1
6) Check the height information
7) Summarize and perform final check on dataset


## Data Validation

Several checks were performed to evaluate the quality and consistency of the merged dataset. These checks examined duplicate player-season observations, missing values, invalid negative statistics, challenge totals, win percentages, and player heights.

The validation process helps identify potential data quality issues before the dataset is used for analysis and visualization.

## Descriptive summaries

```{r}
clean_data = readr::read_csv(
  "../data/processed/merged_data_before_validation.csv"
)
```

```{r}
clean_data <- clean_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
```


```{r check for duplicate records}
# Check for duplicate column names
anyDuplicated(names(clean_data))

# Check for duplicate player-season records
clean_data |>
  dplyr::count(player_key, year) |>
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)
```

```{r check missing values}
colSums(is.na(clean_data))
```

```{r check negative statistics}
clean_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    plate_appearances < 0 |
    games < 0 |
    at_bats < 0 |
    hits < 0 |
    home_runs < 0 |
    walks < 0 |
    strikeouts < 0 |
    challenges < 0
  )
```
  
```{r check challenges}
clean_data |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(challenges)) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    challenge_wins + challenge_losses != challenges
  )
```

```{r check win percentage}
clean_data |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(win_percentage)) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    win_percentage < 0 |
    win_percentage > 1
  )
```

```{r check height}
clean_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(height_inches) &
    (height_inches < 60 | height_inches > 90)
  )

clean_data |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_records = dplyr::n(),
    missing_heights = sum(is.na(height_inches)),
    missing_height_groups = sum(is.na(height_group))
  )
```

```{r final summary}
# Number of player-season records by year
clean_data |>
  dplyr::count(year)

# Average batting statistics by year
clean_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    players = dplyr::n(),
    average_PA = mean(plate_appearances, na.rm = TRUE),
    average_OPS = mean(ops, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ABS challenge summary
clean_data |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(challenges)) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    players_with_ABS_data = dplyr::n(),
    total_challenges = sum(challenges, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_wins = sum(challenge_wins, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_losses = sum(challenge_losses, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Height group summary
clean_data |>
  dplyr::distinct(player_id, height_group) |>
  dplyr::count(height_group)
```

# Write Final Dataset
```{r final dataset}
readr::write_csv(
  clean_data,
  "../data/processed/final_dataset.csv"
)

dim(clean_data)
names(clean_data)
```
